metadata.name: trustgate
metadata.description: TrustGate - Solana program for AI agent trust-gated payments

instructions.name: adopt_passport
docs: Bring a passport under the current protocol scorer with an explicit score and tier
Scorer only

instructions.name: close_merchant_policy
docs: Remove the signer's merchant policy and reclaim rent

instructions.name: close_passport
docs: Close a passport and reclaim rent to authority
Authority only

instructions.name: close_vault
docs: Return the remaining balance to the owner and close the vault
Owner only

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner's token account, receives any remaining balance

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Create a spending vault for one agent and one mint
Owner sets a per-payment limit, a daily limit and an optional recipient allowlist

accounts.name: vault_token
docs: Token account holding the vault's funds, owned by the vault PDA.
Fund it with a normal token transfer.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent key allowed to spend from this vault

instructions.name: freeze_passport
docs: Freeze a passport — blocks all transactions
Authority only
Emits: PassportFrozen event

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Create the global protocol config and set the scorer
Signer must be the program's upgrade authority

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so the config cannot be front-run

instructions.name: initialize_passport
docs: Initialize a new Agent Passport PDA
Creates with trust_score = 0, trust_tier = Bronze, tx_count = 0, frozen = false
Anyone can pay for it; the authority is always the protocol scorer

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent wallet this passport represents

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can create a passport (pays for account creation).
The passport authority is always the protocol scorer, never the payer.

instructions.name: migrate_passport
docs: Migrate an existing passport to the new account layout
Sets default values for new fields (success_count, created_at)
Authority only — idempotent (safe to call multiple times)

instructions.name: process_payment_sol
docs: Process a SOL payment with trust-gate check
Checks: passport must be scored by the protocol scorer
Checks: passport must not be frozen
Checks: trust_tier must meet required_tier and the recipient's merchant policy
Checks: amount must not exceed tier limit
Updates: tx_count += 1, success_count += 1
Emits: PaymentProcessed event

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent initiating the payment

accounts.name: recipient
docs: The recipient of the payment

accounts.name: merchant_policy
docs: Minimum tier set by the recipient. Empty if the recipient never set one.

instructions.name: process_payment_spl
docs: Process an SPL token payment with trust-gate check
Same logic as process_payment_sol but uses token program CPI

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent initiating the payment

accounts.name: agent_token
docs: Agent's token account (source)

accounts.name: recipient_token
docs: Recipient's token account (destination)

accounts.name: merchant_policy
docs: Minimum tier set by the recipient. Empty if the recipient never set one.

instructions.name: set_merchant_policy
docs: Set the minimum trust tier agents need to pay the signer

accounts.name: merchant
docs: The recipient setting its own minimum tier

instructions.name: set_vault_paused
docs: Pause or resume agent payments from a vault
Owner only

instructions.name: unfreeze_passport
docs: Unfreeze a passport — re-enables transactions
Authority only
Emits: PassportUnfrozen event

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Rotate the scorer and/or hand over admin rights
Admin only

instructions.name: update_trust_tier
docs: Update an agent's trust score and tier (called by backend authority only)
The tier is computed off-chain from all scoring signals, so it is passed in
rather than derived from the score
Validates: authority must match passport.authority
Validates: score must be 0-100
Emits: TrustTierUpdated event with old and new tier

instructions.name: update_vault_policy
docs: Change a vault's limits and allowlist
Owner only

instructions.name: vault_pay
docs: Pay from a vault. Signed by the agent, enforced by the program:
Checks: vault not paused, passport trusted and not frozen
Checks: tier meets the recipient's merchant policy
Checks: per-payment limit, daily limit, recipient allowlist
Emits: VaultPayment event

accounts.name: recipient_token
docs: Recipient's token account (destination)

accounts.name: merchant_policy
docs: Minimum tier set by the recipient. Empty if the recipient never set one.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent initiating the payment

instructions.name: vault_withdraw
docs: Withdraw tokens from a vault back to the owner
Owner only

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner's token account (destination)

instructions.name: verify_trust
docs: Read-only trust check for other programs to call by CPI
Fails unless the passport is scored by the protocol scorer, not frozen,
and at or above min_tier. Return data: [trust_score, trust_tier]

errors.name: InsufficientTrustTier
errors.msg: Insufficient trust tier for this operation

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: caller is not the authority

errors.name: InvalidTrustScore
errors.msg: Invalid trust score: must be between 0 and 100

errors.name: UntrustedAuthority
errors.msg: Passport authority is not the protocol scorer

errors.name: InvalidProgramData
errors.msg: Signer is not the program upgrade authority

errors.name: VaultPaused
errors.msg: Vault is paused by its owner

errors.name: ExceedsPerTxLimit
errors.msg: Payment amount exceeds the vault per-payment limit

errors.name: ExceedsDailyLimit
errors.msg: Payment would exceed the vault daily limit

errors.name: RecipientNotAllowed
errors.msg: Recipient is not on the vault allowlist

errors.name: InvalidLimits
errors.msg: Per-payment limit cannot exceed the daily limit

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Token account mint does not match

fields.name: agent
docs: The public key of the agent this passport belongs to

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that can update this passport

fields.name: trust_score
docs: Trust score from 0 to 100

fields.name: trust_tier
docs: Computed trust tier based on score

fields.name: tx_count
docs: Total number of transactions

fields.name: success_count
docs: Number of successful transactions

fields.name: frozen
docs: Whether this passport is frozen (blocked from transactions)

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when passport was created

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Timestamp of last update

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA

types.name: AgentVault
docs: Owner-funded spending account for one agent and one mint
(PDA, seeds = ["vault", owner, agent, mint]).
Tokens sit in a token account owned by this PDA, so the agent key can
only move them through `vault_pay`, which enforces the owner's limits.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that funds the vault and sets its limits

fields.name: agent
docs: Agent key allowed to spend from the vault

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint held by the vault

fields.name: per_tx_limit
docs: Maximum amount per payment (token base units)

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Maximum amount per 24h window (token base units)

fields.name: spent_in_window
docs: Amount spent in the current window

fields.name: window_start
docs: Timestamp the current window started

fields.name: total_spent
docs: Lifetime amount paid out by the agent

fields.name: paused
docs: Owner kill switch: blocks all agent payments while true

fields.name: allowlist_len
docs: Number of used entries in `allowlist` (0 = any recipient)

fields.name: allowlist
docs: Recipient wallets the agent may pay

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA

types.name: MerchantPolicy
docs: Minimum trust tier a recipient requires from agents paying it
(PDA, seeds = ["merchant", merchant]).
Payment instructions always take this PDA, so the paying agent cannot
skip it or pick a lower tier for itself.

fields.name: merchant
docs: The recipient wallet this policy belongs to

fields.name: min_tier
docs: Minimum tier an agent needs to pay this recipient

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration (singleton PDA, seeds = ["config"]).
A passport is only trusted by the gate when `passport.authority == config.scorer`,
so nobody can create a passport and assign themselves a tier.

fields.name: admin
docs: Can rotate the scorer and hand over admin rights

fields.name: scorer
docs: The only key whose scores and tiers the gate accepts

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA
